note: Hand-written stand-in for a model response so the demo runs without an API key. Re-record with --llm record.

output.explanation: The webhook handler marked an order paid on PAYMENT.CAPTURE.PENDING as well as PAYMENT.CAPTURE.COMPLETED. A pending capture means PayPal has not credited the money yet and it can still be denied. Only COMPLETED marks the order paid now; PENDING records the order as pending until the COMPLETED event arrives.
